fvv4mu.description_en:
I've been having a hard time tracking this target down. They're part of a gang known as the Claw Salamanders who tend to be quite itinerate. However, it seems the group has been trying to get an old QV Breaker Station operational again and I think this just may be the chance to take out [TARGET] once and for all.
Start your search at [LOCATION]. These stations can apparently be quiet cavernous at times so it may take a bit of effort to locate the target once you're on site.
However, I have all the confidence in your abilities,
Vaughn
fvv4mu.description_zh:
这目标真的难盯。他属于那帮神出鬼没的爪蜥帮，平时东躲西藏、行踪不定。不过最近听说他们正拼命想重启一座老掉牙的 QV 碎岩站。这倒是个千载难逢的机会，说不定这次真能一劳永逸地干掉 [TARGETNAME]。

先从 [LOCATION] 开始搜起吧。这种前哨站空荡荡的，像个大山洞似的。你一进去怕是得花点力气才能把人揪出来。

但是，我对你有十足的信心，
沃恩

11o6l5s.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR23665
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Operative with extensive combat experience needed to retrieve a blackbox from a compromised ship at [LOCATION]. Client hasn’t specified why they need it but are paying good money to have it back.
Analysis of the wreck indicates that there are some serious hostiles in the area, so any attempt to retrieve will likely require a fight. Our records indicate that these hostiles are highly trained and aggressive, so prepare accordingly.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Route to [LOCATION] and secure the blacbox by any means necessary. Once obtained, deliver it to [DESTINATION] for payment.
Additional Notes:
Operations wanted to reiterate that this will be a heavy combat mission so make sure you bring allies or equipment to handle it.
11o6l5s.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR23665
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
需要一名具有丰富战斗经验的特工从 [LOCATION] 的一艘受损飞船中取出黑匣子。客户没有说明他们为何需要这个黑匣子，但他们愿意支付丰厚的报酬来取回它。

对残骸的分析表明，该地区有一些危险的敌对势力，因此任何取回黑匣子的尝试都可能引发战斗。我们的记录显示这些敌对势力训练有素且具有攻击性，所以请做好相应准备。

合约调查员的行动：
前往 [LOCATION]，想尽一切办法确保黑匣子的安全。一旦拿到黑匣子，将其送到 [DESTINATION] 以获取报酬。

补充说明：
运营部门再次强调，这将是一次高强度战斗任务，请确保带上盟友或相应的装备来应对。

ax3mtz.description_en:
IN-GAME ALSO SHOWN AS
Turning the Tables
Upgrade Grab
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.
Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.
Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.
-Bit Zeros
ax3mtz.description_zh:
好不容易才锁定一件稀有科技，结果却在最后一秒被人截胡。追踪它倒是不难，但我可不想一直追着这东西跑。

去 [LOCATION] 把它给我找回来。那边的人估计压根不知道那玩意儿有多贵重，不如我们帮他们一把，顺手把东西拿走。至于有没有人看守，我也不清楚，怎么应对潜在威胁你自己看着办。

拿到手后，把它送到 [DESTINATION]，到时候我们就给你打信用点。

- 零比特

jukguk.description_en:
Hello,
Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.
We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at [LOCATION].
If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll take care of the rest.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
jukguk.description_zh:
你好，

坏消息。我们的运输员途中遇险，被迫遗弃了本应送达的货物。至今杳无音信，我们只能做最坏打算。

我们正在联系他们的家人，也明白现在是特别敏感的时刻，但实在没法放着任务半途而废。我们的追踪器显示，那批货物还在 [LOCATION] 那儿，完好无损。

要是你能把这批货送完，我们真的非常感激。目前没探测到附近有别的飞船，应该挺安全的，你去取就行。记得带把重型牵引光束，再开一艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船。

把货送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行，剩下的交给我们来处理。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

d4ge5h.description_en:
Violence is never our first choice, but sometimes it must be used as a preventative measure.
We’re planning a strike on a Headhunter controlled outpost and need your help.
We need to make sure that if something goes wrong they won’t be able to call for backup and escalate the situation. That’s where you come in. We need you to head over to [LOCATION] and disable the communication towers. There should be a control panel located at the top of each tower that you can use to deactivate them.
If you’re able to do this, Citizens for Prosperity will be able to gain some vital ground in Pyro.
It’s also worth keeping in mind for future contracts that you can choose to take out the comms towers instead of risking a fight with reinforcement dropships.
Stay alert and stay safe.
Thank you,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
d4ge5h.description_zh:
暴力从来不是我们的首选，但有时必须将其作为预防措施。

我们正计划对一个猎头帮控制的前哨站发动攻击，需要你的帮助。

我们必须确保一旦出了什么问题，就要让他们无法呼叫支援或让局势恶化。这就是你需要出手的地方。你要前往 [LOCATION] 并关闭那些通讯塔。每座塔的 顶部都有一个控制面板，你可以用它来让通讯塔瘫痪。

如果你能完成这件事，繁荣公民就能在派罗取得一些关键的进展。

另外也请记住，今后接取合约的时候，你可以选择直接摧毁通讯塔，避免和增援的运输船正面交火。

保持警惕，注意安全。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

1svqpqd.description_en:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?
See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.
I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the location marker on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.
Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least three friends onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of 16 Council Scrip to the main contractor that pulls it off.
- Stows
1svqpqd.description_zh:
有群杂碎想把咱们挤出星系。想不想给他们点颜色瞧瞧？

听着，有些人真的不希望我们在这待着，他们已经开始派出五到七艘船的猎杀小队，通常还会有一艘火力更强的大型战舰，跑到我们正在建立势力的地方搞事情。是时候让他们知道，我们可不是好惹的。

我在 HUD 上标记了一个位置标记，串起了几个地点，这些地方是我们遭遇敌对行为最频繁的区域。需要你去每个地方扫描一下，看看能不能引诱他们出来干一架。

我知道这任务不容易，所以别太自信想着单干。如果我是你，我会至少带上三个朋友来帮忙。为了让你觉得值，所以答应给完成任务的主承包商额外 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP66432
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Need a skilled operator with combat experience to investigate the last known location of [TARGET]. Their employer hired us to look for they as they were carrying some highly valuable cargo, but the trackers have been disabled and the pilot is no longer responding.
We suspect that outlaws have attacked the ship and seized the cargo for themselves. The client has expressed that they consider the cargo lost but would like to know if the pilot is dead so they can inform their family.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Investigate [LOCATION] and locate the [TARGET]’s ship. If you are able to find the pilot’s body, confirm their status so we may inform the client.
Additional Notes:
Backup is highly recommended for this encounter.

18sqq9l.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Our research team at at [DESTINATION] is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments.
We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.
The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
13acewa.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们在 [DESTINATION] 的研究团队正在不懈努力解决当前的“再生危机”，处理不稳定印记的问题。他们的工作取得了可喜的成果，但缺少的一项关键资源阻碍了他们进行进一步实验的能力。

我们从供应商那里得知，由于需求的增加和采矿的产量下降，我们将无法在接下来的几个月内收到预定的货物。我们的研究团队等不及那么久，我们希望您能提供帮助。

这种资源难以获得，但我们有可靠消息称，旧哈索尔采矿设施建造在资源浓度较高的区域。由于哈索尔在建立其系统内的运营后不久就停业，因此激活其中一个采矿激光器很可能能为我们提供所需的资源。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

1fgcvdd.description_en:
Hello,
Crusader has asked us here at Ling Family Hauling to aid their relief efforts, and it’s extremely important to us as a business and a family to do this right. The thought of what happened to the victims of Orison happening to anyone in my family… We owe it to the survivors to do everything in our power to help them.
The medical supplies Crusader needs are set to get picked up from [LOCATION] and needs to be dropped at [DESTINATION]. And be sure to bring a handheld tractor beam to speed things along.
Thank you,
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
1fgcvdd.description_zh:
哈喽，

十字军已要求我们玲家快递协助他们的救援工作，作为一家公司和一个家庭，做好这件事对我们来说极其重要。一想到奥里森受害者遭遇的惨剧若发生在我的家人身上...我们有责任竭尽全力帮助幸存者。

十字军所需的医疗物资已准备好从 [LOCATION] 取货，并需要投递至 [DESTINATION]。请务必携带一个 手持牵引光束 以加快进度。

谢谢，
康妮·玲
运输协调员
玲家快递

1pw7o6l.description_en:
Headhunters are launching an attack near [LOCATION]. This ex-Marine asshole named [TARGET] has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.
While all the security have been greenlit, [TARGET] has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.
Watch yourself though, [TARGET] may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.
-Stows
1pw7o6l.description_zh:
猎头帮正在 [LOCATION] 附近发起攻击。如果那里的人不投降交出武器的话，一个名叫 [TARGETNAME] 的前海军陆战队混蛋一直在派遣他的雇佣兵去清除那边的营地。

虽然所有的安保措施都已获批，但 [TARGETNAME] 被特别点名。在他们的最后一次突袭中，他们把一个无家可归者打死了，因为那人顶嘴。结果发现那个无家可归者是我们一个小组成员的表亲，所以他们愿意额外支付，以确保正义得以伸张。

不过要小心，[TARGETNAME] 可能是个该得报应的混蛋，但他们毕竟是前军人，所以不容易对付。

- 斯托斯

This shit saddens me. Not sure if you've ever crossed paths with [TARGET] in your dealings with us. Thought they were a real good one. All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to [LOCATION], find [TARGET], and kill them.
Doesn't have to be anything fancy. Just want the result.
Damn shame.
Stows out.
1bxps0y.description_zh:

所有法官都怒火中烧，想要血债血偿，这就是你的任务。前往 [LOCATION]，找到 [TARGETNAME]，然后杀了他。

不需要什么花哨的，只要结果。

真他妈可惜。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Any willing pilots in the area? Need some protection around [LOCATION] for a client. A band of outlaws has been targeting their [OBJECTS], and if nothing's done about it they'll do some real damage. Need someone to protect the client’s property as much as possible and deal with the thugs.

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

附近有没有的原意接单飞行员？我们需要有人为位于 [LOCATION] 的客户提供一些保护。有一伙不法分子正盯上他们的 [OBJECTS]，如果不加以制止，后果将不堪设想。我们需要有人尽可能保护好客户的财产，并解决这些暴徒。

根据我们掌握的情报，这些恶棍虽然只是小角色，但如果不小心应对，他们也能造成不小的麻烦。所以，如果你能按照福克斯韦尔的标准完成这次任务，我们将提供 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证给主承包商。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
